01  —  The Maison

Scent is not worn.
It is remembered.

Maison Ardent composes fragrance as a form of living architecture—built in light, shadow and time. We believe scent is not an accessory, but a memory held in matter.

Each extrait is matured slowly in Grasse and bottled in Paris only when every raw material has found its place. No seasonal trends. No synthetic clamor. Only matter of uncommon depth.

The Olfactory Pyramid

Not a list
of ingredients.
A passage of time.

Lueur unfolds in three temporal movements. Scroll slowly to experience evaporation on skin.

Movement The First Impression

Movement I · The First Impression

Top
Notes

A flash of brightness. Saffron warmed by skin temperature, green bergamot peel broken between fingers, with a dry spark of pink pepper.

Expressing green, effervescent citrus oils with a crystalline solar sparkle that lifts immediately into the air.

SolarHesperidic00 — 20 min

Bittersweet stigmata conferring a golden, metallic glow that prefigures the leathery depth to follow.

SpicedWarm Gold10 — 40 min

A fresh, airy spice with floral and berry nuances, bridging initial brightness into velvety floracy.

PiquantAiry05 — 30 min

Evaporation Duration: 00 — 20 min · High Volatility

Movement II · The Identity

Heart
Notes

The composition draws closer. Photography turns macro; layers overlap. Rose absolute unfurls into powdered Florentine iris and the clean grain of aged cedar.

Honeyed, wine-dark petals hand-harvested at dawn in Grasse, presenting intoxicating richness and deep velvet texture.

Velvet FloralHoneyed30 min — 4 hr

A noble rhizome cured for three seasons in cedar vaults, imparting a powdery, aristocratic suede texture.

PowderySuede1 hr — 6 hr

Architectural heartwood conferring dry warmth, pencil shavings elegance, and an enduring structural spine.

WoodyStructured1 hr — 8 hr

Evaporation Duration: 20 min — 4 hr · Medium Volatility

Movement III · The Memory

Base
Notes

What remains on skin: smoky resinous oud, soft worn saddlery leather and deep petrified amber, made intimate by a trace of skin musk.

Balsamic wood resin harvested sustainably, offering animalic warmth and a contemplative incense trail.

ResinousIncense4 — 14 hr

Soft vegetal leather reminiscent of antique book bindings, warm saddlery, and shadows in an old library.

CuirTactile4 — 12 hr

Golden fossilized resin melted into intimate skin musk that lingers on collars and scarves through the following day.

BalsamicIndelible8 — 24 hr

Evaporation Duration: 4 — 12+ hr · Indelible Persistence
